:::{#def-entropy}
#### Entropy (**differential entropy**, for a continuous random variable)

The **entropy** of a [random variable](random-variables.qmd#def-random-variable) $X$ is the [expectation](#def-expectation) of its [surprisal](#def-surprisal)
([discrete](random-variables.qmd#def-discrete-rv) or [continuous](#def-surprisal-continuous))
[@wikipedia_entropy_information_theory; @cover2006elements, section 8.1],
when that expectation exists:

$$\entropyf{X} \eqdef \E{\surprisalf{X}}.$$

For a [continuous random variable](random-variables.qmd#def-continuous-rv), the entropy is also called the **differential entropy**.

:::
